The risk memo claims the invoice contains "formerly FastShip Ltd.", but that line is missing from the extracted data. The notes only cite PO-20260115 and delivery instructions. The validator also flags a need to confirm the payee matches the entity if remittance details differ.

The invoice total is $9,975, just under the $10,000 threshold. The vendor name matches the master record exactly, including the misspelled "Distributers". All line items and tax calculations are correct. Two findings are noted: one near-threshold flag and one OCR correction for O versus 0 confusion.

The low-risk rating and passing checks mean the invoice should be approved. The near-threshold finding is only informational, so it does not block payment on its own.

The near-threshold finding is not a reason to reject the invoice. The line items are legitimate round commercial amounts that sum naturally to $9,975 with exact 5% tax. There is no evidence of invoice splitting or artificial reduction.

No tool can verify the referenced purchase order. The absence of prior payment history is a data gap, not a document defect. The risk memo also cites "formerly FastShip Ltd.", which is missing from the extracted invoice.

The OCR corrections are benign character confusions that normalize to values consistent with the arithmetic. The low risk memo does not require explicit citation in the reasons because this invoice is under $10,000.

The JSON schema requires every reason to include a finding_ids array. I must list both F1 and F2 in addressed_findings. I will keep the reasons brief and concrete.

The OCR correction covers the date and Widget B amount. The Net 30 due date is valid. Vendor and risk memo details can be cited with empty finding_ids arrays.

The low-risk memo will be cited in the same reason as F1, since the near-threshold finding is the central judgment call. Vendor confirmation and the risk memo will also appear in the summary.

The risk memo's claim about "formerly FastShip Ltd." is not visible in the extracted invoice. No remittance details appear on the document, so that line cannot be verified against the actual text.
